sections.heading: About this policy
sections.body:
Pulse by SBH, also called Pulse, is a personal routine tracker operated by Anthony Charles Hugershoff, sole proprietor operating under the registered Science By Hugs DBA/trade name. This policy covers the Pulse iOS, Android and web apps, related account/support services, and our public policy pages. The service is intended for United States residents aged 18 or older, including beta testers.

sections.heading: Information you provide
sections.body: We collect your account email and authentication information. Optional profile information includes your name, contact phone number and selected profile photo. You may enter protocol and substance names, categories, amounts, units, routes, schedules, dates, injection-site records, completion/skip history, inventory quantities, container dates and lot numbers. Optional daily check-ins include sleep, energy, mood and notes. These records may reveal sensitive health information.

sections.heading: Feedback and app administration
sections.body: Optional in-app feedback includes the message and category you submit, app version, build number, platform and submission/status timestamps. Your tracking records, photos, check-ins and diagnostic logs are not attached. Your verified account email is shown with a ticket only if you choose to allow follow-up. Avoid including health records, passwords or other sensitive details in feedback. Feedback is linked to your account for My feedback, export and account deletion. Interrupted submissions retain their original message and request identifier in private device storage until confirmed or your account is deleted. The private admin portal shows aggregate account/signup counts and volunteered feedback; its endpoints do not expose individual profiles or health tracking records. It uses a separately approved admin account with authenticator verification. Minimal administrator status-change audit records contain ticket identifiers and statuses, not feedback messages or health records.

sections.heading: Information generated by the service
sections.body: We create account and record identifiers, timestamps, local dates, time-zone information, correction history, schedule versions and sync/cancellation records to operate the service. Our hosting and authentication providers may process connection information such as IP addresses, request metadata and security logs. A time zone is not GPS location. The reviewed app does not request precise location or integrate HealthKit or Health Connect.

sections.heading: How we use information
sections.body: We use information to authenticate accounts, save and synchronize your records, display your history, manage inventory, provide user-configured reminders and calendar entries, generate requested exports, support you, and secure and maintain the service. Check-in summaries describe your entries; they do not establish medical causation. Optional profile photos and check-ins are not required for basic tracking.

sections.heading: Promotional email plans
sections.body: We send necessary account, verification, password-reset, security and support messages. Promotional email is not an active in-app feature. If we offer it later, enrollment will be separate and optional, with an unsubscribe method. Declining promotions will not prevent use of core tracking features. We do not use health records to target marketing.

sections.heading: Providers and disclosures
sections.body:
Supabase processes account authentication, synced database records and private profile-photo storage, including email-delivery subprocessors used for account messages. Cloudflare serves our public policy pages and separate admin portal and processes connection information needed for delivery and security. Expo supplies app development libraries/tooling; Pulse does not send tracking records to Expo for advertising or AI training. Apple and Google distribute the mobile apps and provide operating-system services. Their own platform/account processing is covered by their policies.

We limit service-provider access to the data needed for our instructions, support, security and legal obligations. We require providers that receive personal data on our behalf to maintain confidentiality, purpose limits, security and retention/deletion safeguards providing the same or equal protection required by this policy and applicable Apple/Google requirements. Providers may use subprocessors under equivalent protection obligations. We do not authorize independent advertising or health-data monetization by our processors.

The owner and authorized service personnel may access the minimum needed to operate the service, resolve a request or protect it. The admin portal displays aggregate account counts and volunteered feedback, not a directory of health records. We may disclose data when legally required, to protect rights or safety, or in an organizational transfer subject to continued protection and required notice/consent. We do not sell personal information or consumer health data, share it for cross-context behavioral advertising, use health data for advertising or AI-model training, or run in-app advertising, data-broker or advertising-tracking features. We promote the app separately without using your health records.

sections.heading: Your sharing choices
sections.body: Calendar sync is optional. Calendar entries can be accessible to your calendar provider and anyone you allow to access that calendar. Private notification titles are enabled by default; names and quantities can appear if you enable detailed text. Widgets display due counts. PDF reports are generated on your device and are not uploaded to Pulse storage; temporary native report files are removed after sharing finishes. Saved/shared exports and calendar copies are outside Pulse and may be retained by their recipients. Review sharing destinations before sending sensitive records.

sections.heading: Permissions and device storage
sections.body: Photo access selects an optional avatar; the app uploads a resized JPEG rather than your entire photo library. Notification, calendar and biometric-lock features use optional platform permissions. Pulse receives a biometric authentication result, not your face or fingerprint template. Native sessions, cached routine records and pending logs use platform secure storage. The web app uses browser storage for sessions and local state. See our Device Storage Notice for more detail. Optional substance photos are resized and stored on this device only, separately from the backend profile photo. On native devices they use private secure storage; on web they use browser storage. They can be replaced or removed and included in an account export from this device. Unconfirmed creation requests retain their identifiers and original input in private device storage so interrupted saves can be retried without duplicating records. Successful requests are cleared; remaining requests can be included in an account export from that device.

sections.heading: Retention and deletion
sections.body:
We retain account/profile information and synced protocols, logs, inventory, check-ins and feedback while your account exists, unless you remove a supported record or request deletion. Correction and schedule history remain with the account to preserve your tracking history. An unconfirmed signup may remain until it is removed through account-support operations; no automatic 30-day cleanup is currently promised.

Confirmed in-app account deletion removes the authentication account, associated active application records, submitted feedback and stored profile photo. Account-scoped device queues, cached records and local photos are also cleared by the app; if device cleanup reports an error, follow the displayed retry/support instructions. Uninstalling or signing out alone does not delete server records. You may also request account and associated-data deletion without installing or using Pulse by emailing support@sciencebyhugs.com; see Account & Data Deletion.

Provider recovery backups, object-recovery copies and security/operational logs can remain after active records are deleted until their configured rotation or deletion process completes. Their periods depend on the provider, plan, data category and security/legal purpose; Pulse has not verified a single fixed period for every such copy and does not promise immediate or seven-day erasure from all backups. Restricted recovery data is not used for new tracking or marketing; applicable deletion requests are passed to processors, and previously completed deletions must be reapplied if recovery restores affected records.

We retain only the minimum request/audit information needed to verify and document a request, resolve a dispute, prevent abuse or satisfy a specific legal obligation. Minimal feedback-status audit identifiers/statuses can remain without the deleted account actor, message or email. Retention is limited to the period needed for the stated purpose or required by law; we review and remove information when that purpose ends. If a retention exception prevents full deletion, we explain the category, purpose and applicable period or determining criteria unless prohibited by law. Exports, screenshots and calendar copies you or recipients independently retain are outside Pulse; you control those copies.

sections.heading: Your controls and rights
sections.body:
You can review and update supported profile/record fields, export your account data and delete your account in You → Account & Privacy. Remove an optional profile photo, turn off reminders/calendar sync or biometric lock, and revoke photo, notification, calendar or biometric permissions in device settings. Declining optional permissions does not prevent core tracking; only the dependent optional feature is unavailable. Stop entering health information or request deletion if you no longer want Pulse to process it for tracking.

Depending on applicable law, you may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, portability, deletion, withdrawal of consent, restriction, information about recipients, or appeal a denied privacy request. Contact legal@sciencebyhugs.com, or support@sciencebyhugs.com for deletion, using your account email and request type. We verify ownership proportionately without requesting a password or health records by email, and can explain a secure recovery/verification route if you cannot sign in. An authorized representative may contact us with appropriate authority.

We aim to acknowledge requests within three business days and respond within applicable legal deadlines, giving any permitted extension and reasons. You may appeal by emailing legal@sciencebyhugs.com with “Privacy appeal”; we review and explain the result and any applicable regulator complaint route. You may contact your state attorney general or other competent privacy authority. We do not discriminate for exercising privacy rights. Withdrawal does not undo processing that was lawful before withdrawal. Accepting terms or reading a policy is not blanket consent to new or optional health-data uses; any legally required separate consent must be obtained before that use.

sections.heading: Security and international processing
sections.body:
Pulse uses HTTPS for service requests, account ownership restrictions, private profile-photo access and platform secure storage for native sessions and account-scoped local records. Web browser storage has different protections and depends on your browser/device. Server/service personnel with authorized access can process synced information; Pulse is not an end-to-end encrypted service. Protect your device, account and exported copies. No system is perfectly secure.

The primary backend region was verified as us-east-2 (United States) on October 12, 2026. This is not a promise that every service activity remains there. Supabase may process support, account metadata, operational logs/telemetry and content delivery in other countries, using its contractual transfer and security safeguards. Cloudflare distributes public pages through a global network and processes connection information for delivery/security. Platform, email and support providers may also process information internationally. We do not claim HIPAA coverage, a business-associate relationship or regulatory certification for Pulse merely because a provider offers relevant services.

sections.heading: Children and changes
sections.body:
Pulse is intended for United States residents aged 18 or older, including beta and web users. Signup asks for age/residency self-attestation; it does not verify identity/location or collect a birth date or GPS location for eligibility. The confirmation and its date are saved with the account. We do not knowingly offer the service to children. Contact legal@sciencebyhugs.com if you believe a child has provided data so we can investigate and remove it as appropriate.

The effective date and policy version are displayed with this policy. We will notify users of material changes through an appropriate in-app or direct notice and obtain renewed/separate consent where required before new processing. A policy update does not retroactively authorize a new purpose, broader health-data disclosure or reduced protection. These notices describe current practices; Apple App Privacy and Google Data Safety disclosures must also accurately reflect them.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: This Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy supplements the Privacy Policy for Pulse by SBH, operated by Anthony Charles Hugershoff under the Science By Hugs DBA/trade name. It explains the health-related information we collect, why we collect it, who receives it, and your controls and rights. It applies to the United States adult service, including beta testing. The Privacy Policy provides additional security, retention, provider and contact details.

sections.heading: Categories and sources
sections.body: Health data may include your entered substances/medications, quantities, routes, sites, schedules, completion/skips, inventory, sleep, energy, mood and notes, and associated dates, time zones and correction/schedule history. We receive this information from you and generate tracking records from your interactions. The current app does not obtain medical records from a clinician or import health-platform data.

sections.heading: Purposes of collection
sections.body: We collect and process the health-related records you choose to enter to provide the tracking, synchronization, reminders, history, inventory, check-in summaries and exports you request, and to maintain and secure those services. We do not use the records to diagnose, prescribe or choose treatment. We do not sell consumer health data, use it for advertising/marketing or AI-model training, disclose it to data brokers, or operate health-related advertising. Pulse has no in-app advertising. We do not infer a diagnosis or use health data to determine insurance, credit or employment eligibility. We do not use geofencing to identify or target visits to healthcare facilities.

sections.heading: Sharing and recipients
sections.body:
Supabase and its infrastructure subprocessors process synced health records on our behalf for hosting, authentication, security, recovery and service operation, under instructions and protection obligations described in the Privacy Policy. Access by the owner or authorized support/service personnel is limited to what is needed for a requested service, support or security purpose. Cloudflare serves the public notices/admin portal; the static policy host does not receive your Pulse health records.

You may independently choose recipients through exports, calendar sync or detailed notifications. These choices can expose information to your calendar provider, operating-system notification display, recipients or people with access to your device/calendar. We do not send records to a clinician without your choice. Required legal disclosures and protected organizational transfers are described in the Privacy Policy. No independent health-data sale or advertising recipient is authorized. We require processors receiving health data to provide the same or equal applicable policy protections.

sections.heading: Consent and withdrawal
sections.body:
Entering a record asks Pulse to process that record for the selected tracking feature. Core tracking cannot operate without the records you ask it to save. Optional check-ins, profile photos, reminders, calendars, biometric lock and exports are choices; declining an optional feature does not prevent core tracking. System permissions are requested where needed.

We will obtain separate, specific consent before collecting or sharing consumer health data beyond what is necessary for your requested service when applicable law requires it. Consent to collection does not by itself authorize unrelated sharing or sale, and a policy notice or terms acceptance is not a substitute for required consent. No sale of health data is offered or authorized by these policies.

You can withdraw an optional permission/choice in Pulse or device settings, stop new entries, delete the account, or contact legal@sciencebyhugs.com to withdraw consent or request removal. Withdrawal stops the relevant future processing; it does not reverse earlier lawful processing or independently shared copies. We explain any core feature that cannot operate following a requested restriction.

sections.heading: Access, deletion and appeals
sections.body:
Use You → Account & Privacy for export/deletion, or contact legal@sciencebyhugs.com for access, correction, confirmation of processing, information about health-data recipients, withdrawal or appeal. Email support@sciencebyhugs.com to request deletion without the app. We proportionately verify ownership and any representative authority, acknowledge requests as described in the Privacy Policy, and respond within applicable legal deadlines without discrimination.

We communicate applicable deletion/withdrawal requests to our processors and other recipients where legally required, including appropriate recovery-copy handling. If we deny a request or retain a limited legal/security record, we explain the reason and available appeal process unless legally prohibited. Appeal to legal@sciencebyhugs.com with “Privacy appeal.” You can also contact the relevant state attorney general or privacy authority. The Privacy Policy describes retention criteria and independent export/calendar copies.

sections.heading: Agreement and operator
sections.body: These Terms of Use describe the Pulse by SBH service offered by Anthony Charles Hugershoff, sole proprietor operating under the registered Science By Hugs DBA/trade name. The effective date/version are shown with these terms. Please read them before creating an account or using the service. We request affirmative acceptance where required and do not treat notice publication alone as proof of a particular user’s agreement or consent to optional health-data processing.

sections.heading: What Pulse provides
sections.body: Pulse records the routines and quantities you enter, schedules reminders, tracks inventory and displays descriptive history/check-in summaries. It does not provide clinical services or recommend substances, doses, administration methods or treatment changes. Tracking a substance does not establish that it is lawful, approved, safe or effective. Do not use Pulse to make urgent medical decisions.

sections.heading: Eligibility and account responsibilities
sections.body: Pulse is intended for United States residents who are at least 18 years old and legally able to enter an agreement, including beta testers and web users. Signup asks you to confirm that eligibility; it is self-attestation rather than verified identity or location. Provide accurate account information, protect credentials and report suspected unauthorized access. Check your own entries and follow qualified medical advice. Never share account passwords with support.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.body: Use Pulse lawfully. Do not use it to promote illegal activity, upload content you have no right to use, access another person’s records without authorization, compromise security, abuse infrastructure or misrepresent records. Pulse is not a marketplace for substances and provides no authorization to buy, sell or use any substance.

sections.heading: Your records and permission to operate
sections.body: You retain rights in your records and photos. You give the operator the limited permission needed to store, process, display, synchronize and export content to provide the features you request and meet lawful obligations. This is not permission to sell health records or train AI on them. The Privacy and Consumer Health Data Privacy policies explain processing and rights.

sections.heading: Reliability and sharing
sections.body: Reminders can be delayed or blocked by device settings, permissions, connection or platform behavior. Inventory projections depend on entered quantities, schedules and container dates; they are estimates rather than safety/stability guarantees. Confirm important records independently. You control export destinations and calendar sharing; recipient copies may remain after deleting your account.

sections.heading: Beta availability and payments
sections.body: Beta features can change and may contain errors. Pulse is free at launch, with no subscriptions or in-app purchases. Any future paid services require updated pricing, renewal, cancellation and refund information before purchase.

sections.heading: App license and platform terms
sections.body: Pulse grants permission to use the app for lawful personal tracking, subject to applicable terms and mandatory rights. App intellectual property remains with its owners; third-party components retain their licenses. Apple and Google platform terms continue to apply. These service terms do not replace the license applicable to an App Store download, including Apple’s standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement when that license governs your download. Apple and Google do not provide Pulse’s tracking service or medical advice.

sections.heading: Suspension, termination and changes
sections.body: You may stop using the service and delete your account. The operator may restrict use where reasonably necessary for security, legal compliance or serious misuse, subject to applicable law. Material changes will be notified appropriately and require renewed acceptance where applicable. A privacy-policy update does not retroactively authorize new health-data uses.

sections.heading: Consumer rights and liability
sections.body: Mandatory consumer, privacy and other rights remain unaffected. Pulse does not guarantee uninterrupted service or the accuracy of user-entered records, reminders or estimates. These terms do not exclude or limit liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited, including any non-waivable rights or remedies. No mandatory arbitration, class-action waiver, fixed liability cap or exclusive court/choice-of-law clause is imposed by these terms. Disputes remain subject to applicable law and available legal remedies. Contact support@sciencebyhugs.com to seek resolution of a service issue.

sections.heading: Tracking boundaries
sections.body: Pulse by SBH is a personal record of the routine you enter. Pulse is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Do not use it as clinical decision support or to decide whether a substance or routine is appropriate for you.

sections.heading: Clinical decisions
sections.body: Pulse does not prescribe, recommend doses, choose an injection site or establish whether a peptide, medication or supplement is safe or effective. Consult a qualified clinician or pharmacist before starting, stopping or changing a substance or routine. Follow their instructions and the product’s lawful labeling. A substance name in your records does not imply approval or endorsement.

sections.heading: Reminders and inventory
sections.body: Do not rely on Pulse as your only reminder or clinical record. Reminders and sync can be interrupted. Supply estimates and user-entered expiry/use-by dates do not assess product potency, sterility, storage suitability or stability. Logging or skipping an entry does not determine what you should do next.

sections.heading: Emergency use
sections.body: Pulse is not monitored for emergencies. If you suspect an emergency, contact your local emergency service or seek immediate professional care. Check-in notes are not a clinician messaging service.

sections.heading: Reports
sections.body: Reports reproduce selected user-entered information. They may omit unavailable historical details and are not verified clinical assessments. Review them before sharing.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: This notice describes device/browser storage used by Pulse and the separate public policy pages. It supplements the Privacy Policy and Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy. A separately operated marketing website or a newly introduced integration has its own disclosures; changes affecting Pulse data will be disclosed before activation as required.

sections.heading: Native app
sections.body: Pulse uses platform secure storage for authentication sessions, cached records and pending tracking events. Local app preferences support notification privacy, biometric lock and related settings. Device/OS settings may also affect backups and storage. Temporary generated PDF files are removed after sharing completes; copies you save remain in your selected destination. Optional substance photos are stored per account/substance on this device, not uploaded to Pulse or an image-generation provider. Unconfirmed creation requests retain their identifiers and original input in private device storage so interrupted saves can be retried without duplicating records. Successful requests are cleared; remaining requests can be included in an account export from that device.

sections.heading: Web app
sections.body: The web app uses browser storage for sign-in sessions and app state. This is not the native secure-store implementation. Signing out ends local authenticated use; account deletion removes associated synced data. Clearing browser storage can remove cached and unsynced information and sign you out.

sections.heading: Policy pages and optional tracking
sections.body:
The public policy pages do not set cookies, run JavaScript analytics, embed third-party fonts or advertising, or load tracking pixels. Cloudflare hosts these pages and processes request/connection information such as IP address and browser/request metadata for network delivery and security under its provider obligations. The static host does not submit forms, receive account credentials, fetch Pulse health records or intentionally record request bodies.

Pulse does not include an advertising identifier, advertising network or behavioral analytics SDK. Providers and operating systems may still process the operational/security information described in the Privacy Policy. Any future non-essential tracking requires appropriate disclosure and consent before activation where required; it will not be silently enabled by a policy update.

sections.heading: Controls
sections.body:
Use Pulse and device settings to manage optional permissions and privacy controls. Clear browser storage to remove local web state; this can discard unsynced records and sign you out but does not delete your server account. Uninstalling the app is not a server-account deletion request, and operating-system secure storage/backups can have separate lifecycles. Use Account & Privacy or the external deletion contact to delete associated active account data. Revoking calendar permission does not necessarily remove events already created; remove Pulse-created calendar events before disconnecting/deleting if you want those copies removed.

sections.heading: Interrupted feedback submissions
sections.body: If a feedback submission is interrupted, its original message, category, follow-up consent choice, version/build, platform and request identifier remain in private storage on this device so the same ticket can be retried without duplication. The saved retry record is scoped to the signed-in account and is removed after confirmed submission or account deletion. A message that has never been submitted remains only in the open form and is discarded if you choose to close it.

sections.heading: Delete inside Pulse
sections.body: Open Pulse, sign in and go to You → Account & Privacy. Choose Delete account & data and confirm the destructive action. Deletion removes the account, not merely disables it. The server removes the stored profile photo and authentication account; associated active profile, protocol, item, inventory, tracking, correction, schedule-history, check-in and submitted-feedback records are removed through account deletion. No purchase, subscription cancellation, phone call or support approval is required for this in-app request. The app must receive server confirmation; an error is not a completed deletion. The app then clears account-scoped local queues, caches, retry records and photos. If local cleanup reports a problem, follow the displayed retry/support instructions.

sections.heading: Request deletion without the app
sections.body: You can initiate deletion of your Pulse account and associated data without installing, reinstalling or opening Pulse. Email support@sciencebyhugs.com with the subject “Pulse account deletion” and your account email. You do not need to send a password, health records or identity document in the initial email. We will explain a proportionate secure verification process before deleting data, especially if you cannot sign in. We do not reject a request solely because you no longer have the app. Privacy/legal questions: legal@sciencebyhugs.com.

sections.heading: What can remain
sections.body:
Account deletion removes associated active Pulse records and stored profile photos after confirmation. Copies you export or share, screenshots, and third-party calendar/recipient copies are outside Pulse; remove them from their destinations if desired. Deleting local app storage or uninstalling alone does not remove server records.

Provider recovery backups, object-recovery copies and operational/security logs may persist until the provider’s configured rotation/deletion cycle completes; the period depends on provider, plan, data type and purpose. Pulse does not promise immediate or a fixed seven-day erasure of all copies. Applicable deletion requests are communicated to processors and completed deletions must be reapplied if recovery restores affected records.

Only the minimum privacy-request/audit, security, dispute or legally required information is retained for the purpose and period necessary or required by law. Minimal feedback-status audit identifiers/statuses may remain without the deleted account actor, message or email. We review retention and explain any exception, category and period or determining criteria unless prohibited by law. Retained recovery/legal data is not used for new tracking or advertising. The Privacy Policy gives the full retention criteria.

sections.heading: Export before deleting
sections.body: You can choose Export data in Account & Privacy before deletion. Store the export securely. Deletion is permanent for active account records and cannot be undone through the app.

sections.heading: Request tracking and contact
sections.body:
Anthony Charles Hugershoff monitors support@sciencebyhugs.com for deletion/support and legal@sciencebyhugs.com for other privacy requests and appeals. We aim to acknowledge requests within three business days, verify ownership proportionately, and fulfill valid requests within applicable legal deadlines. If an extension or limited denial is legally permitted, we explain it and the appeal route. For appeal, email legal@sciencebyhugs.com with “Privacy appeal.” You may also contact the relevant state attorney general or privacy authority. We do not charge for ordinary valid requests or discriminate for exercising rights.
